annotations.title: List the XBRL concepts a company reported

description: List every XBRL concept a company reported (us-gaap, ifrs-full, dei, srt, invest), with label, definition, units, value count and period span. Use it to find concepts to read with facts.as_reported (paginated).

as_of.description: Optional date (YYYY-MM-DD); only values filed by then are counted.

search.description: Optional text the concept name or label must contain, ignoring case.

taxonomy.description: Optional taxonomy to keep: us-gaap, ifrs-full, dei, srt or invest.
